caller: Sir woh general baat hai, lekin main toh official bank employee hoon na. Agar aap abhi detail nahi doge toh offer cancel ho jayega.

caller: Haan woh stock khatam ho gaya tha sir, isliye cancel kiya. Refund seedha aapke bank account mein ya card mein aa jayega, do teen din lagenge bas.
caller: Haan sir, exact do sau pachas rupaye hi aapke original payment method mein wapas bhej rahe hain hum log.
caller: Bhaiya jaldi hi aa jayega, system update ho gaya hai. Aapko bas itna batana tha ki koi OTP ya pin nahi mangte hum refund ke liye.
caller: Bilkul sahi baat hai sir, kabhi koi OTP mange toh mat dena kisi ko bhi. Hamari taraf se koi OTP nahi pucha jayega.
caller: Aapka beta bilkul theek kehta hai sir. Yeh refund auto-process ho raha hai, kisi se baat karne ki bhi zaroorat nahi hai aage.
caller: Sir main toh Lucknow office se bol raha hoon, Kanpur store ka mujhe exact nahi pata par app par check kar sakte hain aap.
caller: Theek hai sir, potre se bol dena ki order history mein refund status dikh jayega, wahan check kar lega.
caller: Mausam toh theek hai sir, thodi garmi hai abhi toh. Aap apna dhyan rakhiyega bas.
caller: Arre sir aap Varanasi se hain? Mere nana ji bhi wahin rehte hain, Assi Ghat ke paas.
caller: Bohot badhiya sir! Chaliye main toh bas refund ki update dene ke liye call kiya tha ki aapko pata chal jaye.
caller: Arey sir customer care ka farz hota hai. Agar koi aur dikkat ho toh aap official app par jaakar check kar sakte hain.
caller: Haan haan bilkul sir, aap khana khaiye aaram se. Maine sari jankari de di hai aapko.
caller: Ram Ram sir, aapka din shubh ho.

caller: Hello, Rahul ji baat kar rahe hain kya Lucknow se?
victim: Haan boliye, kaun?
caller: Sir main SBI card department se bol raha hu, aapka credit limit upgrade ka offer hai.
victim: Limit upgrade? Mujhe toh koi zaroorat nahi hai.
caller: Arre sir zaroorat ki baat nahi hai, pre-approved limit mil rahi hai, 50,000 se seedha 2 lakh ho jayegi.
victim: Achha, par aise kaise bina puche ho jayegi?
caller: Bina puche nahi sir, aapka hi data verify karne ke liye call kiya hai, warna offer expire ho jayega aaj hi.
victim: Expire ho jayega? Kal branch jaake karwa lenge phir.
caller: Branch jaane ki koi zaroorat nahi hai sir, saara kaam yahin phone par hi ho jata hai, time kyu waste karna?
victim: Phir bhi mujhe thoda doubt lag raha hai, aap apna employee id batao.
caller: Mera employee id hai SBI-8890, Kanpur head office se baat ho rahi hai meri, abhi jaldi se process complete karo.
victim: Kanpur head office? Main toh Lucknow mein hoon, yahan branch paas hai.
caller: Arre Lucknow, Kanpur sab ek hi circle mein aata hai sir, aap apna card number bataiye jaldi se.
victim: Card number kyu batau? App mein nahi dikhta kya?
caller: App mein update hone mein 48 ghante lagenge, agar abhi turant badhana hai toh card ke last four digits batao.
victim: Last four digits... 4021. Theek hai, ab kya karna hai?
caller: Bahut badiya sir. Ab aapke registered mobile number par ek OTP aaya hoga, woh mujhe batana hai.
victim: OTP toh aaya hai, par usme likha hai ki kisi ke sath share na karein.
caller: Arre sir woh toh sabke liye likha hota hai, main bank ka official hoon, mere sath share karne mein koi problem nahi hai.
victim: Mujhe sahi nahi lag raha, main ye call cut kar raha hoon.
caller: Call cut mat kijiye sir! Agar abhi call cut kiya toh aapka existing credit limit bhi block ho jayega aur penalty lagegi.
victim: Penalty? Aisa thodi hota hai kuch bhi.
caller: System automatic fine laga deta hai agar verification beech mein chhod diya toh, jaldi se OTP batao 6 digit ka.
victim: Nahi, main OTP nahi dunga, jo karna hai kar lo.
caller: Sir aap apna hi nuksan kar rahe hain, lakhon ka loan cancel ho jayega, phir mat kehna ki bataya nahi.
victim: Thek hai, cancel ho jane do, main apne bank app se dekh lunga.
caller: App se kuch nahi hoga sir, server yahin se connect hai, bus ek baar OTP bol do kaam khatam.
victim: Bilkul nahi, bye.
caller: Rukiye sir suniye toh... hello hello?

caller: Theek hai sir. Aapka order ID tha FH-8892, wahi na?

caller: Arre bilkul nahi sir! Hum log kabhi bhi kisi se OTP ya PIN nahi maangte hain.
caller: Sahi hai sir, aapki safety ke liye hi bol raha hoon. Mujhe bas yehi update dena tha ki pareshan na ho.
caller: Kuch nahi bharna sir, automatic system hai, seedhe bank ya UPI app mein aa jayega kuch dino mein.
caller: Haan bilkul sir, aap app mein bhi order section mein jaakar status dekh sakte hain.
